audit.whatIsWrong: Ashe is misgendered as 'his/he/him' in tldr, winCon, report[0].t, report[1].t, and report[9].t (champ-gender.js marks Ashe female). breakdown.cooldowns names Enchanted Crystal Arrow as matchup-defining but never gives its cooldown number. dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.why: champ-gender.js is authoritative on pronouns and lintFindings confirm Ashe is she/her throughout this matchup. R's real cooldown is 100/80/60s per the kit. dosFull[1] is titled about W-sustain but its body is a Q/W/E poke sequence; dontsFull[2] is titled about standing in front of your support but its body is about wasting the echo on W.
audit.corrected: Swapped his/he/him to her/she/her in the five flagged fields; added the 100/80/60s cooldown to breakdown.cooldowns; rewrote dosFull[1].d to describe the W shield/heal duo mechanic; rewrote dontsFull[2].d to explain the positioning risk of standing in front of your support.

edits.before: Echoed Q the contact, W the trade-back, E the disengage — the song taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: W shields, and only heals once you're already shielded — land both casts every exchange so the free sustain, not raw damage, wins the extended trade.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W out of rhythm — the third note is the champion; wasting it is singing scales.
edits.after: Ashe's autos and Volley cone reach your position before they reach your support's — stay behind their body and peel, don't soak range you don't have.
